summary: Bag with watch, phone and cash stolen from a sunbed at the public pool
story: On July 14 I went swimming at the public pool at Montjuic. I left my bag on a sunbed and swam lengths for about forty minutes. When I got out the bag was gone, with my watch, my phone and some cash. I went to the police station that afternoon and they gave me a report. I have listed what was in it.

documents.name: Police report
documents.content: Mossos d'Esquadra, Barcelona. Report made July 14, 2026 at 17:20 by Tomas Brandt. He left a bag on a sunbed at the Montjuic municipal pool at about 13:00 and swam until about 13:45. On return the bag was missing, with a watch, a phone and about EUR 220 in cash.

documents.name: Receipts
documents.content: Watch, bought 2023: $380.00. Smartphone, bought 2025: $310.00. Cash withdrawn at an ATM on July 13: $240.00.

summary: Phone snatched from my hand on the promenade
story: On August 3 I was walking on the promenade at Cascais and checking directions on my phone when a man on a scooter grabbed it out of my hand and rode off. I reported it to the police within the hour. I had been swimming earlier but my bag was with me the whole time. The phone was bought fourteen months ago and I added Electronics Plus when I bought the policy.

documents.name: Police report
documents.content: Policia de Seguranca Publica, Cascais. Report made August 3, 2026 at 18:05 by Priya Nair. At about 17:30 on the Marginal promenade a man on a scooter took her phone from her hand.

summary: Disc pain and sciatica needing an emergency admission in Santiago
story: On August 6 I woke with severe pain down my left leg and could not stand. I was admitted overnight in Santiago and had an MRI. I did have some back trouble last spring, which I mention in case it matters. Once I got home I had four physiotherapy sessions, which I have also listed.

items.description: Four physiotherapy sessions at home after the trip

documents.name: Hospital bill and records
documents.content: Clinica Santa Maria, Santiago, August 6 to 7, 2026. Diagnosis: lumbar disc herniation with left sciatica. History: one visit to a physician for a lower back strain on April 10, 2026, treated with rest and stretching; no medication prescribed; no further visits.

documents.name: Itemized bill
documents.content: Emergency assessment $540.00; MRI $1,180.00; orthopedic consultation $320.00; medication $46.50; overnight observation $610.00.

summary: Held overnight in Split by a ferry crew strike on the way home
story: Our ferry from Split to Ancona on September 13 was due to leave at 20:00 and left at 09:00 the next morning because the crew went on strike. We had a hotel room in Split for the night and paid for meals and taxis. We also lost our first night's hotel in Bologna, which we had already paid for. Receipts are attached.

items.description: Hotel in Split, one room, one night
First night's prepaid hotel in Bologna, missed

documents.name: Ferry delay confirmation
documents.content: Adria Lines. Sailing AL 212 Split to Ancona, scheduled September 13, 2026 at 20:00, departed September 14 at 09:00 because of a strike by the crew. Passengers: Owen Castell and Mara Castell.

documents.name: Receipts
documents.content: Hotel Marjan, September 13 to 14: $168.00. Restaurant Fish Door, dinner: $54.30. Cafe Riva, breakfast: $21.40. Taxis: $18.00 and $18.00. Hotel Torre, Bologna, no-show September 14: $140.00.

summary: Trip to Vietnam cancelled because my visa did not arrive
story: I applied for my Vietnam visa five weeks before the trip. The visa office was closed for several days and the visa had not arrived by August 12, so I could not travel on August 20. The airline and the hotel will not refund me. I would like my costs back.

documents.name: Visa office email
documents.content: Your application is still being processed. The office was closed from August 5 to August 11 and applications are taking longer than usual.

documents.name: Supplier confirmations
documents.content: Skylark Airways: ticket not refundable, $1,480.00. Hotel Lotus: prepaid stay not refundable, $820.00.
